Diego —

Good summary. Quick guidance from my side:

1) Term: push back on 24 months. Offer 30 months as a compromise with the following concession: a 12-month price hold (no increases) and an option to revisit capacity pricing at the 18-month mark. This gives TruNorth some runway and protects our unit economics.

2) Termination for convenience / 90-day ask: do not accept unconditional 90-day post-12mo. We can accept a limited right to terminate for convenience with a pro-rated termination fee equal to 30% of remaining committed months' subscription. This preserves predictable revenue.

3) Billing trigger for upsell: Ops can define an objective metric: "upsell tranche activates when 7 consecutive days of usage average >= 120% of baseline concurrent tokens". Priyom, can you confirm we can instrument that in billing with a 7-day lookback and an automated notification to customer?

4) Audit window & SOC2: Laura — confirm SOC2 Sent over last quarter and 45-day window ok (we usually require 30-60 days depending on scope).

If legal is uncomfortable, offer a 30-day window for limited-scope audits.

Assuming Priyom/Laura confirm, Diego send an updated redline back to TruNorth outlining the 30-month compromise and the termination fee structure. Attach a clean marked-up so they can see the positions.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Sales, Redwood Inference
